## Not guaranteed

Everything tagged "appearance, approximate" in the part, and every illustration choice. It is shown for looks only and is not checked against a catalogue dimension:

- The slit width (not printed; drawn 1 mm) and the gap between the two halves of C-SCNPAW (not printed; drawn 0.5 mm)
- Position and depth of the clamp screw hole (the catalogue prints only its thread size M; drawn on the mid-wall radius at mid width, tapped right through)
- Which half of C-SCNPAW is tapped and which has the clearance hole (both are drawn tapped)
- Chamfers and edge breaks (none printed)
- The clamp and fixing screws themselves (not drawn)
- The bore is drawn at the nominal D; the printed +0.05/+0.01 is the tolerance before cutting
- C-SCSBNAW and the urethane collars: the slit width of C-SCSBNAW (not printed; drawn 1 mm), the position of its clamp screw hole (mid-wall radius, mid ring width b, tapped right through), and the diagonal notch drawn on its front view (not drawn)
- E-xSCD / E-xSCDJ / E-xSCSPD: the urethane damper as a plain disc of thickness t, outer diameter D1 and bore D on the face z = 0 (the catalogue draws it as a hatched strip; its shape, hardness grade and fit are not dimensioned), and the damper is not slit or split
- E-xSCD / E-xSCDJ / E-xSCSPD: which half is tapped (drawn: the half at -X) and which has the clearance hole d, the length of the tapped hole (right through that half), the depth and flat floor of the head seat (drawn as a U-shaped slot of width 2R open to the outside, floor at the printed Y), and the reference range Z of the slit (not drawn; printed in brackets as a reference)
- E-xSCD / E-xSCDJ / E-xSCSPD: the screw positions along the axis (centred on the steel width B1), chamfers (printed 'Chamfering' without a size), the screws themselves (not drawn), the bore tolerance (drawn nominal; +0.06/+0.01 slit, +0.05/+0.01 split, E-SCD up to +0.08) and D1 +-0.1
